name: NARC Remade  - No Animals Report Crimes for Skyrim SE
summary: Tired of that chicken going up to the guards and being a nark? Annoyed because that one bear ratted you out? Upset because horses are snitches? Then this is the mod for you!

name: Realistic Ragdolls and Force SE
summary:
(ESP plugin)Reduces the extra force applied on ragdolls to a more reasonable level
(MESH)Replaces ragdolls so that they bend and twist realistically and fall at a faster velocity, and increases friction to fix ice-like ragdoll sliding

name: Instant Mining
summary: Harvest ores instantly, with no animation (like alchemy ingredients). Makes no changes to the items you receive, and includes a version that removes the need to carry a pickaxe.

name: Wintersun - More interesting Mara
summary: Add some functionalities to the worshippers of mara to keep it interesting while attempting to keep it balanced.

name: No Silly Physics Damage - Carts Pots Bones etc
summary: You will no longer lose HP when walking on dynamic objects such as bones or when walking towards a cart.

name: Don't Push Me Around
summary: My personal take on the silly 'player pushed around' issue. --- esl

name: Barter Limit Fix
summary: SKSE plugin that fixes trading with merchants with more than 32,767 gold.

name: The Choice is Yours
summary: Stop quests from starting automatically. Pursue the quests you want, ignore the ones you don't.  Make your choices matter.

name: Essential Favorites
summary: SKSE plugin that prevents favorited items from being sold, crafted, disarmed, disenchanted, or dropped.

name: Equip Enchantment Fix
summary: Fixes engine bugs where item enchantments don't apply when equipped or stop working while the item is still equipped. SKSE64 plugin.

name: Wait Your Turn - Enemy Circling Behaviour
summary: A lightweight combat add-on mod that adds circling behaviour to enemies. Now, group combat is more fair and fun for the player, as enemies will no longer attack all at once without a pattern. Lightweight, compatible other combat overhaul mods, and can be turned off or tweaked using the MCM. Requires SKSE64, SPID, and PapyrusUtil to be installed

name: Draugr Shout less
summary: Isn't it strange that Draugr can shout much faster than The Last Dragonborn? Yes, yes it is. That's what this mod is for.

name: Yet Another Attempt at fixing Giant Physics and Clubs
Know Your Enemy - Trait-based resistances and weaknesses
summary: Uses a trait system to change the resistances and weaknesses of creatures and armors to magic (fire/frost/shock), physical damage (blade/blunt/axes/arrows), poison and disease.

name: Sailboats - Script Free Sailing EXPANDED SSE - Simplified and Traditional Chinese Translation
summary: "划船 - 无脚本扩展版" 简中繁中汉化补丁

name: Landlord Special Edition Spanish
summary: Traducciones al español de Landlord Special Edition

name: Fast Travel from Interiors
summary: This mod allows the player to fast travel out from interiors. Other versions here and on Bethesda Net were spotty for me.
